# A mintable plan

An accepted plan whose `## Tasks` section is in the mintable format (025 §9.1).
Importing it must mint nothing: the import states the status directly rather
than going through the accept transaction.

## Tasks

### Task 1 — First task

```yaml
kind: feature
priority: high
```

Do the first thing.

### Task 2 — Second task

```yaml
kind: bug
priority: medium
```

Do the second thing.
